Built by src/build_mature_cohort_figures.py, which recomputes each figure from the record's stored grid by the extraction's own estimator at the pinned commit and assembles the evidence from results/mature_cohort/ and the error-rate study. figure_m is in millions of the report's own currency (figure_gbp_m at the loader's H.10 rate, for reference). Under ANALYSIS_CONFIG['outcome'] 'mature_cohort' (the primary) run_analysis.py (apply_mature_cohort_figure) adopts figure_m before the basis and cohort decisions and before the FX conversion, writes route 'mature_cohort_triangle' (gross, mature-enforced), and refuses an entry unless every model block of the record shows the displaced gross triangle; under 'precedence_672' the register is not applied. An entry with a figure carries at least two readings, each with its reader, pages and cells: the readings of 22 October 2026 (kind 'reading'), earlier readings of the error-rate study that recomputed the same printed triangle (kind 'error_rate_study'), and, where only one reader read the record, the extraction's own table read of the printed page (kind 'extraction_table_read', the stored grid the estimator computed from). An entry without a figure states its reason (confirmed_figure_register, no_mature_cohort, triangle_figure_stands, outside_working_sample_not_read, aggregated_column_not_like_for_like), and the loader adopts nothing for it. status 'excluded_takeon_not_development' marks a figure whose record data/takeon_not_development.json excludes (an entry there with figure_route 'mature_cohort_triangle').
